blocks.text: A pie layout turns values into angles. An arc generator uses those angles to draw slice paths.
Use a browser project with D3 7 installed. These module examples append an SVG to the page. Run one example at a time with a bundler; the plain playground does not include D3.

items: `join` creates, updates and removes selected elements to match the bound data.
`d3.pie` calculates slice angles; an arc generator uses those angles to draw the visible paths.

blocks.text: The circle is divided into shares of 20%, 30% and 50%.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use only a few categories and provide labels or a table. Colour alone does not tell a reader the values.
